WITH overtakes AS (
    SELECT
        l1_A.race_id,
        CAST(l2_A.lap AS INTEGER) as lap,
        l1_A.driver_id as driver_A,
        l1_B.driver_id as driver_B
    FROM f1.main.lap_positions l1_A
    JOIN f1.main.lap_positions l2_A
        ON l1_A.race_id = l2_A.race_id
        AND l1_A.driver_id = l2_A.driver_id
        AND CAST(l1_A.lap AS INTEGER) = CAST(l2_A.lap AS INTEGER) - 1
    JOIN f1.main.lap_positions l1_B
        ON l1_A.race_id = l1_B.race_id
        AND CAST(l1_A.lap AS INTEGER) = CAST(l1_B.lap AS INTEGER)
        AND l1_A.driver_id != l1_B.driver_id
    JOIN f1.main.lap_positions l2_B
        ON l1_B.race_id = l2_B.race_id
        AND l1_B.driver_id = l2_B.driver_id
        AND CAST(l1_B.lap AS INTEGER) = CAST(l2_B.lap AS INTEGER) - 1
    WHERE CAST(l2_A.lap AS INTEGER) > 1
      AND CAST(l1_A.position AS INTEGER) > CAST(l1_B.position AS INTEGER) -- A was behind B
      AND CAST(l2_A.position AS INTEGER) < CAST(l2_B.position AS INTEGER) -- A is now ahead of B
)
SELECT * FROM overtakes LIMIT 10;

WITH driver_positions AS (
    SELECT
        race_id,
        driver_id,
        CAST(lap AS INTEGER) as lap,
        CAST(position AS INTEGER) as position
    FROM f1.main.lap_positions
),
driver_moves AS (
    SELECT
        race_id,
        driver_id,
        lap,
        position,
        LAG(position) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) as prev_position
    FROM driver_positions
),
overtakes AS (
    SELECT
        A.race_id,
        A.lap,
        A.driver_id as driver_A,
        B.driver_id as driver_B
    FROM driver_moves A
    JOIN driver_moves B
        ON A.race_id = B.race_id
        AND A.lap = B.lap
        AND A.driver_id != B.driver_id
    WHERE A.lap > 1
      AND A.prev_position > B.prev_position -- A was behind B
      AND A.position < B.position -- A is now ahead of B
)
SELECT * FROM overtakes LIMIT 10;

CREATE TEMP TABLE dm AS
SELECT
    A.race_id,
    A.driver_id,
    A.lap,
    A.position,
    B.position as prev_position
FROM dp A
JOIN dp B
    ON A.race_id = B.race_id
    AND A.driver_id = B.driver_id
    AND A.lap = B.lap + 1;

SELECT * FROM dm LIMIT 10;

CREATE TEMP TABLE overtakes AS
SELECT
    A.race_id,
    A.lap,
    A.driver_id as driver_A,
    B.driver_id as driver_B
FROM dm A
JOIN dm B
    ON A.race_id = B.race_id
    AND A.lap = B.lap
    AND A.driver_id != B.driver_id
WHERE A.lap > 1
  AND A.prev_position > B.prev_position
  AND A.position < B.position;

SELECT * FROM overtakes LIMIT 10;

    driver_id,

SELECT o.*
FROM overtakes o
LEFT JOIN ps ps_A_L

    AND o.driver_A = ps_A_L.driver_id

    ON o.race_id = ps_A_L1.race_id
    AND o.driver_A = ps_A_L1.driver_id
    AND o.lap = ps_A_L1.lap + 1
LEFT JOIN ps ps_B_L
    ON o.race_id = ps_B_L.race_id
    AND o.driver_B = ps_B_L.driver_id
    AND o.lap = ps_B_L.lap
LEFT JOIN ps ps_B_L1
    ON o.race_id = ps_B_L1.race_id
    AND o.driver_B = ps_B_L1.driver_id
    AND o.lap = ps_B_L1.lap + 1
WHERE ps_A_L.lap IS NULL
  AND ps_A_L1.lap IS NULL
  AND ps_B_L.lap IS NULL
  AND ps_B_L1.lap IS NULL;
